items.quote: If you are a real estate agent in Dubai in 2024 then with a 90% probability, you think that your biggest problem is... You Don't Know How to CLOSE THE CLIENT!?
items.statement: 90% of real estate agents think their biggest problem is closing clients.

items.quote: And only approximately 10% know that closing is easy... Only if and when you use the right "Qualification and Engagement techniques".
items.statement: Approximately 10% of agents know that closing is easy with the right techniques.

items.quote: Write 10% in a comments and I'll share my recent training with you.
items.statement: The author offers to share recent training when commenters write '10%'.

overview: LinkedIn post discussing sales strategies for real estate agents in Dubai.
